muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle.
﴿أيها﴾: the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda); and هـا is for drawing attention (tanbīh).
﴿المدثر﴾: an attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿قم﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت).
﴿فأنذر﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أنذر is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "you" (أنت); and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وربك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the word رب is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is muḍāf, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فكبر﴾: the fāʾ is linking, for an implied condition; and كبر is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت).

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿وثيابك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ثياب is a fronted object, and it is muḍāf, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فطهر﴾: the fāʾ is linking, for an implied condition; and طهر is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿والرجز﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الرجز is a fronted object.
﴿فاهجر﴾: the fāʾ is linking, for an implied condition; and اهجر is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت).

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive (nāhiya).
﴿تمنن﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت).
﴿تستكثر﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "you" (أنت); and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿ولربك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is a preposition, and رب is a genitive noun; it is muḍāf, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اصبر﴾.
﴿فاصبر﴾: the fāʾ is linking, for an implied condition; and اصبر is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb for future time containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what the response indicates, because the meaning is: "when the trumpet is sounded, the matter becomes hard for the disbelievers".
﴿نقر﴾: a past verb, built for other than the agent (passive).
﴿في الناقور﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نقر﴾; and the clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿فذلك﴾: the fāʾ: linking, for the response of ﴿إذا﴾; and ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; the reference is to the time of the sounding.
﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم: a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative; it is indeclinable because it is annexed to a non-declinable word, namely ﴿إذ﴾. And إذٍ: a noun indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for a clause, the implied form being: "that, on the day when the Trumpet is blown, is a hard day". [Translator's note: so in the source («نفخ في الصور»); the wording of this ayah is ﴿نقر في الناقور﴾.]
﴿يوم﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿عسير﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿يوم﴾, nominative.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿على الكافرين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عسير﴾.
﴿غير﴾: a second naʿt (adjective) of يوم, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; and it is muḍāf.
﴿يسير﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿ذرني﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت); and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is for accompaniment (maʿiyya), and مَن: mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); or the wāw is a conjunction, and مَن is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the object in ذرني.
﴿خلقت﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the tāʾ of the agent; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The referential pronoun is omitted, i.e.: "whom I created".
﴿وحيدا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted referential pronoun, accusative (manṣūb). It has also been said: a ḥāl from the accusative pronoun in ذرني, or from the tāʾ in خلقت.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿وجعلت﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; جعلت is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the tāʾ of the agent.
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted element, which is the second object.
﴿مالا﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿ممدودا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿مالا﴾, accusative.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وبنين﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿مالا﴾, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.
﴿شهودا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿بنين﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ومهدت﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; مهدت is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the tāʾ of the agent.
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مهدت﴾.
﴿تمهيدا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī).
﴿يطمع﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), conjoined (maʿṭūf) to جعلت and مهدت; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿أن﴾: a subjunctive particle.
﴿أزيد﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by ﴿أن﴾, its fāʿil a latent pronoun, its implied form being: "I" (أنا); and أن with what falls within its scope is construed as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يطمع﴾.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿إنه﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its ism (noun); and inna with what follows is a causal (taʿlīliyya) clause.
﴿كان﴾: an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb; the ism of kāna is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو); and the clause كان is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿لآياتنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عنيدا﴾.
﴿عنيدا﴾: the khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿سأرهقه﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future, and أرهقه is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "I" (أنا); and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿صعودا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, because أرهقه contains the meaning of أكلفه ("I will burden him with"). If أرهقه does not contain the meaning of أكلفه, then ﴿صعودا﴾ is in the place of the accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e.: "I will distress him with hardship".

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿إنه﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its ism (noun).
﴿فكر﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو); and the clause ﴿فكر﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿وقدر﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿فكر﴾; it is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "he" (هو).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿فقتل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and قتل is a past verb whose agent is not named (passive), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿كيف﴾: an interrogative noun, accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in قدر.
﴿قدر﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent, its implied form being: "he" (هو).

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence and delay (tarākhī).
﴿قتل﴾: a past verb whose agent is not named (passive), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿كيف﴾: an interrogative noun, accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in قدر.
﴿قدر﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent, its implied form being: "he" (هو).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence and delay (tarākhī).
﴿نظر﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence and delay (tarākhī).
﴿عبس﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿وبسر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and بسر is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "he" (هو).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence and delay (tarākhī).
﴿أدبر﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿واستكبر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and استكبر is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "he" (هو).

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿فقال﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (قال is) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿إن﴾: negating.
﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿سحر﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿يؤثر﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, whose agent is not named (passive); its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, its implied form being: "it" (هو); and the clause is an attribute (ṣifa) of ﴿سحر﴾.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿إن﴾: negating.
﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿قول﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ); and it is muḍāf.
﴿البشر﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿سأصليه﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future, and أصليه is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied ḍamma because of heaviness; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "I" (أنا); and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿سقر﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; and the whole clause is a badal (substitute) of His saying: ﴿سأرهقه صعودا﴾.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), and ما is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أدراك﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو); the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of ما.
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿سقر﴾: the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ); and the clause ﴿ما سقر﴾ stands in, in the position of the accusative, in place of the second and third objects of the verb ﴿أدراك﴾, which is suspended (muʿallaq) from operating by the interrogative. And the clause ﴿وما أدراك ما سقر﴾ is parenthetical with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿تبقي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هي); the object is omitted; and the clause ﴿لا تبقي﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negating.
﴿تذر﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "it" (هي); the object is omitted; and the clause ﴿لا تذر﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿لا تبقي﴾.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿لواحة﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "it" (هي).
﴿للبشر﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لواحة﴾; and the clause is a second ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿عليها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿تسعة عشر﴾: a compound numeral, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa of both parts, in the position of the nominative as the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is a third ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negating.
﴿جعلنا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to ﴿نا﴾; and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿أصحاب﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); and it is muḍāf.
﴿النار﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿ملائكة﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negating.
﴿جعلنا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to ﴿نا﴾; and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil.
﴿عدتهم﴾: عدة is the first mafʿūl bihi, accusative; it is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction.
﴿فتنة﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
﴿للذين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فتنة﴾.
﴿كفروا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is attached to the wāw, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ليستيقن﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl), and يستيقن is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the second ﴿جعلنا﴾. It has also been said: they are attached to an implied verb, i.e.: "We did that so that … may be certain".
﴿الذين﴾: a relative (noun), indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil.
﴿أوتوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is attached to the wāw; it is built for an unnamed agent (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause أوتوا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿الكتاب﴾: the second object of ﴿أوتوا﴾, accusative.
﴿ويزداد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and يزداد is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يستيقن﴾, subjunctive.
﴿الذين﴾: a relative (noun), indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil.
﴿آمنوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is attached to the wāw, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إيمانا﴾: tamyīz (specification), accusative by the fatḥa.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negating.
﴿يرتاب﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive by conjunction with يستيقن.
﴿الذين﴾: a relative (noun), indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil.
﴿أوتوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is attached to the wāw; it is built for an unnamed agent (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; and the clause ﴿أوتوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿الكتاب﴾: the second object of أوتوا, accusative.
﴿والمؤمنون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and المؤمنون is conjoined to الذين.
﴿وليقول﴾: conjoined to what preceded; the lām is the lām of cause, and (يقول is) an imperfect verb, subjunctive by أن implied optionally after the lām of cause.
﴿الذين﴾: a relative (noun), indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil.
﴿في قلوبهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿مرض﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); and the clause ﴿في قلوبهم مرض﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿والكافرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الكافرون is conjoined, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural.
﴿ماذا﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a fronted object of ﴿أراد﴾.
﴿أراد﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative by the ḍamma.
﴿بهذا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أراد﴾.
﴿مثلا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from هذا, accusative; and the clause ﴿ماذا أراد الله بهذا مثلا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿كذلك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يضل.
﴿يضل﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative by the ḍamma.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
﴿يشاء﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو); the referential pronoun is omitted; and the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويهدي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and يهدي is an imperfect verb, nominative, conjoined to ﴿يضل﴾.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
﴿يشاء﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "he" (هو); the referential pronoun is omitted; and the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and ما is negating.
﴿يعلم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative.
﴿جنود﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi, accusative; and it is muḍāf.
﴿ربك﴾: رب is muḍāf ilayhi, and it is muḍāf, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction.
﴿هو﴾: the fāʿil of يعلم, nominative; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negating.
﴿هي﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction.
﴿ذكرى﴾: khabar, nominative by an implied ḍamma because pronouncing it is impossible.
﴿للبشر﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ذكرى﴾.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿والقمر﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and a preposition, and القمر is genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of oath; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being: "I swear" (أقسم).

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿والليل﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and a preposition, and الليل is genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of oath; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being: "I swear" (أقسم).
﴿إذ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to the implied verb of the oath.
﴿أدبر﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "it" (هو); and the clause أدبر is in the position of the genitive by the adverb being put in annexation to it.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿والصبح﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and a preposition, and الصبح is genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of oath; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being: "I swear" (أقسم).
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb of time, attached to the implied verb of the oath.
﴿أسفر﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "it" (هو); and the clause ﴿أسفر﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the adverb being put in annexation to it.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿إنها﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿ها﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿لإحدى﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and إحدى is the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied ḍamma because pronouncing it is impossible; and it is muḍāf.
﴿الكبر﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the clause of the response to the oath.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿نذيرا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun concealed in الكبر, or tamyīz (specification).
﴿للبشر﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نذيرا﴾.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿لمن﴾: a badal (substitute) of His saying: ﴿للبشر﴾, with the preposition repeated.
﴿شاء﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو); and the clause شاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿منكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle.
﴿يتقدم﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "he" (هو); and أن with what falls within its scope is in the place of the accusative by ﴿شاء﴾.
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿يتأخر﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive by conjunction with ﴿يتقدم﴾, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: "he" (هو); and the clause has no grammatical position, by conjunction with the ṣila clause.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿كل﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); and it is muḍāf.
﴿نفس﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr).
﴿بما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رهينة﴾.
﴿كسبت﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the fāʿil (agent) is: "it" (هو).
﴿رهينة﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception.
﴿أصحاب﴾: excepted (mustathnā), accusative (manṣūb); and it is muḍāf.
﴿اليمين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿في جنات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: "they are in gardens"; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿يتساءلون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause is a second khabar, or a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿عن المجرمين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتساءلون﴾.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿سلككم﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is: "it" (هو); and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿في سقر﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سلككم﴾; the clause سلككم is the khabar (predicate); and the clause ما is the object of an omitted saying, in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "saying".

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿قالوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿لم﴾: a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive.
﴿نك﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being an implied sukūn on the nūn that was dropped for lightness; and the ism (noun) of نكُ is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: "we" (نحن).
﴿من المصلين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿ولم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive.
﴿نك﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being an implied sukūn on the nūn that was dropped for lightness; and the ism (noun) of ﴿نكُ﴾ is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: "we" (نحن).
﴿نطعم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent, its implied form being: "we" (نحن); and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of kāna.
﴿المسكين﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿وكنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the clause being conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; kāna is an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿نخوض﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "we" (نحن); and the clause is in the position of the khabar (predicate) of kāna.
﴿مع﴾: an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نخوض﴾; and it is muḍāf.
﴿الخائضين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿وكنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the clause being conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; kāna is an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its ism (noun).
﴿نكذب﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "we" (نحن); and the clause is in the position of the khabar (predicate) of kāna.
﴿بيوم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نكذب﴾; and it is muḍāf.
﴿الدين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿حتى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition.
﴿أتانا﴾: a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿اليقين﴾: postponed fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ما is negating.
﴿تنفعهم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿شفاعة﴾: postponed fāʿil (agent), nominative; and it is muḍāf.
﴿الشافعين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and ما is an interrogative noun of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿عن التذكرة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿معرضين﴾.
﴿معرضين﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun concealed in the khabar; and the clause ﴿فما لهم...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿كأنهم﴾: kaʾanna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and هم is its ism (noun).
﴿حمر﴾: the khabar (predicate) of kaʾanna, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿مستنفرة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حمر﴾, nominative; and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun concealed in معرضين.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿فرت﴾: فرت is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), referring to the asses (الحمر); and the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; ﴿من قسورة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فرت﴾; and the clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حمر﴾.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿بل﴾: transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī).
﴿يريد﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿كل﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative; and it is muḍāf.
﴿امرئ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr).
﴿منهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كل﴾.
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle.
﴿يؤتى﴾: an imperfect verb whose agent is not named (passive), subjunctive (manṣūb); its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو); and أن with what falls within its scope is in the place of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿صحفا﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi of يؤتى.
﴿منشرة﴾: a naʿt of ﴿صحفا﴾, accusative.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿بل﴾: transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī).
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿يخافون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿الآخرة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿إنه﴾: inna is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its ism (noun).
﴿تذكرة﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ).

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and من is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿شاء﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو); and the object is omitted.
﴿ذكره﴾: a past verb; its fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the condition with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negating.
﴿يذكرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception.
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle.
﴿يشاء﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb); and the maṣdar is an exception from the most general of states.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative.
﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أهل﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative.
﴿التقوى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وأهل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and أهل is conjoined (maʿṭūf), nominative; and it is muḍāf.
﴿المغفرة﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position.
